title: #ChatGPT is tired of doing your homework...
author: NoAutoPilotYT

comments.author: NoAutoPilotYT
comments.body:
Been working on how to frame our AI game for gamers who may not know what AI Agents or LLM's are. Here's a way that seems to be working a bit on our socials.  


ChatGPT is tired of doing your homework...

And now it's taken a vampire's form, trapped you in it's lair, and plans to feast on you at sundown.

Can you escape before it's too late?
